claim_boundary: Synthetic design and power discovery only. Paired schedule excess is normalized in score space and is the sole operational refusal channel; cumulative kappa is diagnostic. Decision-facing one-sided bounds use a Bonferroni correction over the complete 15-cell geometry-by-eta table; no joint two-sided 95% interval claim is made. Synthetic raw eta and score-space eta are scorer metadata and enter neither detector. A non-refusal means only that this detector did not reject, not that condition invariance was proved. A positive refusal result cannot establish real-text opportunity detection, personality validity, clinical safety, or a universal construct/state separation theorem.
